legacyContent.summary: A Hebrews 2:1–4 sermon warning Christians against drifting away through neglect and emphasizing that separation from Christ and salvation is possible. It identifies spiritual currents that contribute to drifting and urges greater earnestness toward the teachings that have been heard.
legacyContent.doctrinalEmphasis: The sermon explicitly rejects 'once saved always saved' and teaches the possibility of falling away from Christ through neglect or departure.
closingResponse: Believe that Jesus is the Messiah

brl.idNote: SER-HEB-004 is retained as an existing legacy series-planning label; it is not treated here as a newly assigned permanent BRL sermon ID.

provenance.notes: Metadata records the legacy source without rewriting or modernizing the sermon.
